decisive_items: dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern
The tumor was in close contact with peripheral nerves
tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
response.rationale: The deep-wall malignant features (atypia, mitoses, infiltration) plus nerve association and S100/neurofilament positivity in an NF1 patient strongly indicate MPNST. R2 only cites the NF1 history without malignant histology; R1 lacks malignant features; R3 is excluded by negative smooth muscle actin.

rejected.why: Only S100 positivity and bland superficial pattern; no malignant features or nerve association.
History of NF1 and neurofibromas is supportive but does not account for the malignant deep-wall proliferation.
Negative for smooth muscle actin and desmin contradicts leiomyosarcoma; only fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia is mentioned.
